findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "diamond?pillar=cryptography-ast" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: weigh_agent_on_scales_of_maat_w3c_vc · Private data: verify_sovereign_shield_merkle, simulate_diamond_spiral_budget, weigh_agent_on_scales_of_maat_w3c_vc, verify_a2a_mcp_symbiotic_bridge · Public sink: verify_sovereign_shield_merkle · Destructive: simulate_diamond_spiral_budget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: weigh_agent_on_scales_of_maat_w3c_vc · Private data: verify_sovereign_shield_merkle, simulate_diamond_spiral_budget, weigh_agent_on_scales_of_maat_w3c_vc, verify_a2a_mcp_symbiotic_bridge · Public sink: verify_sovereign_shield_merkle · Destructive: simulate_diamond_spiral_budget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "simulate_diamond_spiral_budget" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
